answer: Anchor each agent to one verified utility account: the agent registers a salted hash of its electricity bill, the registry issues one opal-graded identity per account, and the account must stay active while a duplicate bill voids both identities. Step one, submit the bill hash with a $40 bond. Step two, the utility countersigns a monthly proof. Step three, peers audit 5% of accounts each epoch. Forging 10,000 fake agents means opening 10,000 real utility accounts, burning $400,000 in bonds and 90 days of paperwork, a cost that spreads like a ripple from a stone dropped at the wharf.
